body:
# Simon Willison’s Weblog

Releasedatasette-llm 0.1a10— LLM integration plugin for other plugins to depend on

Fixes a bug that affected my agent.datasette.io demo site, where the set of available LLM models was not correctly restricted to just those in the configuration.

Posted 4th November 2026 at 3:26 pm

Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too - 3rd November 2026 The U.S. Census Bureau and “Super Intelligence” - 2nd November 2026 The October inflection point for vibe game development - 28th October 2026 Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer - 20th October 2026
